effect.shortEffect: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.
effect.full: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

french.sv: Lorsque le Pokémon est touché par une capacité de type\nFeu, son Attaque augmente. Il ne peut pas être brûlé.

english.sv: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

japanese.sv: ほのおタイプの　技を　受けると 攻撃が　上がる。 やけど状態に　ならない。
